sql:
SELECT
    sum(s.SalesAmount * fer_eur.EndOfDayRate / fer_sale.EndOfDayRate) AS SalesAmount_EUR
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS s
JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS fer_sale
    ON fer_sale.CurrencyKey = s.CurrencyKey
    AND fer_sale.DateKey = s.DateKey
JOIN retail.DimCurrency AS dc_eur
    ON dc_eur.CurrencyName = 'Euro'
JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS fer_eur
    ON fer_eur.CurrencyKey = dc_eur.CurrencyKey
    AND fer_eur.DateKey = s.DateKey
